knowledge_units.claim: Kairos needs to be thought of ambiently, akin to Heidegger's understanding of the Umwelt
Heidegger reads being as being-present (Anwesenheit) in the Greek understanding
Heidegger interprets Aristotle's pathe as Befindlichkeiten, not static knowledge
Perception, interpretation, desire, action, and judgment all cluster around phantasia
Phantasia is connected to kinesis — it is itself a kind of motion in the soul
Phantasia for Aristotle is not 'a mixture of sensation and judgement' as Plato believed; it is a distinct faculty
The discriminating power and the time of its exercise must be one and undivided
Dioksis and phyge are basic ways of being-moved for psyche/being-there
In De Anima, perception of magnitude is tied to phantasia as 'comparative seeing'
Kinesis gives the authentic Da-Charakter to Dasein

reasoning_edges.note: Ambient kairos dissolves the subject-object dichotomy; kairos wills the human not vice versa
Now-time is the levelled-off residue of world-time (§81).
Pre-ontological understanding belongs to Dasein's constitution (§4, H.12–13).
The Present is released from the future (§65, H.327–328).
The question asks about the meaning of Being; it depends on a prior (pre-ontological) understanding of Being to get started.
All sight is grounded in understanding (§31, H.146–147).
Umwelt is subjective; Umgebung is objective surroundings (p.43); subjective realities vs. objective surroundings (pp.129-130)
Environmental security inversely proportional to number of objects (p.100)
Territory is purely an Umwelt problem — exclusively subjective product (p.107)
Dwelling-shell is for plants what Umwelt is for animals; lacks functional cycles (pp.150-151)
Score is written across multiple Umwelten; each organism contributes a voice (pp.190-193)
